# Alizé Residence Đà Nẵng

> Alizé Residence is a luxury oceanfront condotel and penthouse complex situated directly on My Khe Beach in Da Nang, Vietnam. Developed by A&T Group with aerodynamic architectural design by AEDAS, the project features 39 above-ground floors and 3 basements.

## Project Overview

- **Project Name**: ALIZÉ RESIDENCE
- **Developer**: A&T Group & DXMD Vietnam
- **Architectural Design**: AEDAS (World's leading architectural design consultant)
- **Location**: Vo Nguyen Giap Street & Vo Van Kiet intersection, My Khe beachfront, Da Nang City, Vietnam
- **Total Area**: 2,867 sq.m
- **Project Scale**: 1 tower (39 above-ground floors, 3 basements, 145m height)
- **Property Type**: Luxury Hotel Apartments & Seafront Penthouses (Căn hộ khách sạn & Dinh thự biển cao cấp)

## Concept & Architecture

- **Theme**: "Nghệ thuật 'riêng tư' của gió" (The "Private" Art of the Wind).
- **Core Philosophy**: A tranquil symphony on the shores of My Khe. Where the trade winds that once guided ocean journeys now return to My Khe beach, blending with the bustling life to open up another artistic journey: returning to one's own private rhythm of life.
- **Design Language by AEDAS**: Soft curves, continuous wave-form balconies, and open spaces swept by the sea breeze, allowing Alizé to move with the rhythm of the ocean.
- **Materials**: Natural stone facade, triple-glazed Low-E acoustic & thermal glass, Villeroy & Boch sanitaryware, aerothermal energy-efficient ventilation.

## Location & Connectivity

- Situated at the prime coastal corridor of Vo Nguyen Giap Street, Son Tra District, Da Nang.
- Direct beachfront positioning on My Khe Beach.
- 10 minutes to Da Nang International Airport, 5 minutes to Dragon Bridge, 25 minutes to Hoi An Ancient Town.
